notes.title: Patch Notes - 22nd November 2024
notes.content:
Greetings!

Bringing you a new update with improvements and fixes to enhance Oversleep. Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] The memory game has been simplified to be more intuitive and engaging. Test your memory skills with a smoother and more enjoyable experience.
[*] Fix the ending sequence so players don't miss anything.
[*] Resolved an issue where the underwater overlay didn't properly cover larger screens.
[*] Added a Basketball room hint
[*] The audio levels in the final room have been adjusted to reduce excessive noise.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and happy gaming!

notes.title: Update: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
# Update: Bug Fixes and Improvements

We've rolled out a minor update based on feedback:

- **Final Room Bug Fixed**: The issue causing the final room to end prematurely has been resolved.

- **Orb Room Adjustment**: We've improved orb item responsiveness.

- **Menu Music Volume**: The initial volume of the menu music will now not blow your ears off.

- **Default Monitor Setting**: The game now starts on your primary monitor by default.

- **Invert Y-Axis Option**: Added an option to invert the mouse Y-axis to support different preferences and accessibility devices.

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback. Happy puzzling!

*— Toasted Games*

notes.title: Update 1.0: New Achievements, Collectibles, Speedrun Mode & More!
notes.content:
Hello Oversleepers!

We're thrilled to bring you a massive update packed with new features and improvements. Here's what's waiting for you in the latest version of our game:

---

🌟 New Achievements & Collectibles

Unleash your inner completionist with a brand-new set of achievements! From mastering challenges to uncovering secrets, there's plenty to keep you engaged. Plus, we've added collectibles hidden throughout the game world - can you find them all?

---

⏱️ Speedrun Mode & Leaderboards

Think you've got what it takes to beat the clock? Dive into our Speedrun Mode! Race through levels as fast as possible and see how you stack up against players worldwide on the new leaderboards. Glory awaits the swiftest among you!

---

🌐 Now Available in 6 New Languages

We're delighted to welcome players from around the globe! The game is now fully localized in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese. Switch languages in the settings menu and puzzle in your preferred language.


---

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Polish

Our team has been hard at work squashing bugs and refining gameplay:

Optimized performance for smoother gameplay on all devices.

Thank you for your feedback and patience!

---

Happy Gaming,

The Toasted Games Team
